title: BreeUp launch film

voice.style: Warm, assured and unhurried, like a respected Nigerian broadcaster introducing something genuinely useful to neighbours. Nigerian English accent.

music: About fifty seconds of original, cinematic but warm instrumental music for a brand launch film. West African flavour: talking drum accents, shaker, warm electric guitar, soft strings and piano. Starts gentle and curious, lifts at around twelve seconds into a confident groove around 100 BPM, settles to a warm resolved ending. Room for a voice on top, no vocals.
